H8007H.name: Salma
H8007H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8007H.brief: Son of Hur, founder of Bethlehem
H8007H.short: Salma was the son of Hur and the  father (ie founder) of Bethlehem, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H8007G.name: Salmon
H8007G.brief: Son of Nahshon; husband of Rahab; ancestor of David
H8007G.short: Salmon (or Sala) was the son of Nahshon and husband of Rahab - an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

H8072.name: Samlah
H8072.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8072.brief: King of Edom before Israel had kings
H8072.short: Samlah was a king of Edom who reigned before Israel had kings, as mentioned in the genealogies of Esau.

H8050G.name: Samuel
H8050G.desc: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
H8050G.brief: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings
H8050G.short: Samuel was a prophet and the last judge of Israel before the establishment of the monarchy, who anointed both Saul and David as kings.

H8014.name: Shalmai
H8014.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8014.brief: Nethinim ancestor whose descendants returned from Babylonian exile
H8014.short: Shalmai (or Shamlai) was an ancestor of the Nethinim, and his descendants were among those who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

H8022.name: Shalmaneser
H8022.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8022.brief: Assyrian king who conquered Samaria and exiled Israelites
H8022.short: Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, besieged Samaria and conquered the northern kingdom of Israel, exiling its inhabitants and ending the kingdom's existence.

H8091.name: Shama
H8091.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8091.brief: Mighty man in David's army, a Harodite
H8091.short: Shama, the son of Hotham the Aroerite, was one of the mighty men in David's army.

H8044.name: Shamgar
H8044.brief: Judge of Israel who killed 600 Philistines
H8044.short: Shamgar, the son of Anath, was a judge of Israel who delivered the nation by killing 600 Philistines with an oxgoad.

H8049.name: Shamhuth
H8049.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8049.brief: Fifth division commander in David's army
H8049.short: Shamhuth the Izrahite was the commander of the fifth division in David's army, serving during the fifth month.

H8069I.name: Shamir
H8069I.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8069I.short: Shamir (or Shamur) was a Levite descended from Uzziel, the son of Kohath.

H8037H.name: Shamma
H8037H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8037H.brief: Son of Zophah, descendant of Asher
H8037H.short: Shamma was a son of Zophah and a descendant of Asher.

H8037G.name: Shammah
H8037G.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H8037G.brief: Mighty man in David's army, defended a lentil field
H8037G.short: Shammah, one of David's mighty men, single-handedly defended a lentil field against the Philistines, resulting in a great victory for Israel.

H8048H.name: Shammah
H8048H.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H8048H.brief: Mighty man in David's army, a Harodite
H8048H.short: Shammah (or Shammoth) the Harodite was one of David's mighty men, known for his bravery and skill in battle.

H8048I.name: Shammah
H8048I.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H8048I.brief: Mighty man in David's army, son of Agee the Hararite
H8048I.short: Shammah (or Shagee) the Hararite, the son of Agee, was one of David's mighty men, known for his bravery and skill in battle.

H8048G.name: Shammah
H8048G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8048G.brief: Son of Reuel, grandson of Esau
H8048G.short: Shammah was a son of Reuel and a grandson of Esau, and he became a chief of Edom.

H8060G.name: Shammai
H8060G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8060G.brief: Son of Onam; father of Nadab and Abishur
H8060G.short: Shammai, the son of Onam, was the father of Nadab and Abishur, who were descendants of Jerahmeel, the son of Hezron.

H8060H.name: Shammai
H8060H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8060H.brief: Father of Maon, ancestor of Caleb
H8060H.short: Shammai was the father of Maon and an ancestor of Caleb, a prominent figure in the tribe of Judah.

H8060I.name: Shammai
H8060I.short: Shammai, the son of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh and Mered who was a descendant of Judah.

H8051H.name: Shammua
H8051H.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H8051H.brief: Son of David born in Jerusalem
H8051H.short: Shammua (or Shimea) was one of the sons of David born to him in Jerusalem.

H8051I.name: Shammua
H8051I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8051I.brief: Priest during the time of Nehemiah
H8051I.short: Shammua was a priest who served during the time of Nehemiah and was a signatory to the covenant renewal.

H8051G.name: Shammua
H8051G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8051G.brief: Spy from the tribe of Reuben
H8051G.short: Shammua, the son of Zaccur, was the spy representing the tribe of Reuben who was sent to explore the land of Canaan.

H8018G.name: Shelemiah
H8018G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8018G.brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife
H8018G.short: Shelemiah, an Israelite who married a foreign wife during the time of Ezra.

H8018H.name: Shelemiah
H8018H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8018H.brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife
H8018H.short: Shelemiah, another Israelite who married a foreign wife during Ezra's time.

H8018K.name: Shelemiah
H8018K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8018K.brief: Grandfather of Jehudi, who read Jeremiah's scroll
H8018K.short: Shelemiah, the grandfather of Jehudi, who read Jeremiah's scroll to the officials.

H8018L.name: Shelemiah
H8018L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8018L.brief: Sent with Jerahmeel to arrest Jeremiah
H8018L.short: Shelemiah was sent with Jerahmeel to arrest Jeremiah and Baruch.

H8018N.name: Shelemiah
H8018N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8018N.brief: Father of Irijah, who arrested Jeremiah
H8018N.short: Shelemiah, the father of Irijah, the guard who arrested Jeremiah.

H8018M.name: Shelemiah
H8018M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8018M.short: Shelemiah, a priest during King Zedekiah's reign; father of Jehucal.

H8018J.name: Shelemiah
H8018J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8018J.short: Shelemiah, a priest appointed by Nehemiah as a treasurer.

H8018I.name: Shelemiah
H8018I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8018I.brief: Levite who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall
H8018I.short: Shelemiah, a Levite who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

H8026.name: Sheleph
H8026.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8026.brief: Son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
H8026.short: Sheleph, a son of Joktan and descendant of Shem.

H8028.name: Shelesh
H8028.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8028.short: Shelesh, a son of Hotham (or 'Helem'), from the tribe of Asher.

H8015.name: Shelomi
H8015.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8015.brief: Father of Ahihud, a leader from Asher
H8015.short: Shelomi, the father of Ahihud, a leader from the tribe of Asher.

H8019A.name: Shelomith
H8019A.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8019A.short: Shelomith (or Shelomoth), a Levite of the family of Izhar.

H8019I.name: Shelomith
H8019I.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8019I.short: Shelomith, a son of Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah after the exile.

H8019G.name: Shelomith
H8019G.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8019G.brief: Daughter of Rehoboam with Absolom's daughter
H8019G.short: Shelomith, of King Rehoboam with Absalom's daughter Maacah.

H8019H.name: Shelomith
H8019H.desc: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
H8019H.brief: Descendant of Bani who returned from exile
H8019H.short: Shelomith, a descendant of Bani who returned from Babylonian exile.

H8019B.name: Shelomith
H8019B.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8019B.short: Shelomith, the mother of a man who blasphemed God's name.

H8013G.name: Shelomoth
H8013G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8013G.short: Shelomoth (or Shelomith), Levites of the family of Shimei, son of Gershon.

H8013H.name: Shelomoth
H8013H.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8013H.short: Shelomoth, a Levite treasurer during King David's reign.

H8017.name: Shelumiel
H8017.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8017.brief: Leader of the tribe of Simeon
H8017.short: Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai, leader of the tribe of Simeon during the wilderness wanderings.

H8035.name: Shem
H8035.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8035.brief: Noah's son, ancestor of Semitic peoples
H8035.short: Shem, one of Noah's three sons and the ancestor of the Semitic peoples.

H8087G.name: Shema
H8087G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8087G.short: Shema, a son of Hebron and descendant of Judah.

H8087H.name: Shema
H8087H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8087H.short: Shema, a descendant of Reuben, son of Joel.

H8087I.name: Shema
H8087I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8087I.short: Shema, a son of Elpaal and a descendant of Benjamin.

H8087J.name: Shema
H8087J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8087J.brief: Stood beside Ezra during the reading of the Law
H8087J.short: Shema, one of the men who stood beside Ezra during the public reading of the Law.

H8094.name: Shemaah
H8094.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8094.short: Shemaah, a Gibeathite warrior from Benjamin who joined David at Ziklag.

H8098G.name: Shemaiah
H8098G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098G.short: Shemaiah, a Levite of the sons of Elizaphan, who helped bring the ark to Jerusalem.

H8098H.name: Shemaiah
H8098H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098H.short: Shemaiah, a Levite scribe who recorded the divisions of the priests.

H8098I.name: Shemaiah
H8098I.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H8098I.short: Shemaiah, a Levite gatekeeper, son of Obed-Edom, during David's reign.

H8098B.name: Shemaiah
H8098B.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098B.short: Shemaiah, a descendant of King Solomon, mentioned twice in the genealogy.

H8098C.name: Shemaiah
H8098C.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098C.short: Shemaiah, a descendant of Simeon, son of Shimri.

H8098D.name: Shemaiah
H8098D.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098D.short: Shemaiah, a descendant of Reuben, son of Joel.

H8098E.name: Shemaiah
H8098E.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098E.short: Shemaiah, a Levite who resided in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H8098F.name: Shemaiah
H8098F.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098F.short: Shemaiah (or Shammua), a Levite who served as a gatekeeper and singer in Jerusalem.

H8098A.name: Shemaiah
H8098A.desc: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
H8098A.brief: Prophet during the reign of Rehoboam
H8098A.short: Shemaiah, a prophet who delivered messages to King Rehoboam of Judah.

H8098J.name: Shemaiah
H8098J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098J.brief: Levite who taught the Law during Jehoshaphat's reign
H8098J.short: Shemaiah, a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

H8098K.name: Shemaiah
H8098K.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098K.short: Shemaiah, a Levite of the sons of Heman who helped cleanse the temple during Hezekiah's reign.

H8098L.name: Shemaiah
H8098L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098L.short: Shemaiah, a Levite who assisted in distributing the offerings during Hezekiah's reign.

H8098M.name: Shemaiah
H8098M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098M.short: Shemaiah, a Levite who contributed to the Passover offerings during Josiah's reign.

H8098P.name: Shemaiah
H8098P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098P.brief: Priest who married a foreign woman
H8098P.short: Shemaiah, a priest who was among those who had married foreign women during the exile.

H8098Q.name: Shemaiah
H8098Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098Q.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman
H8098Q.short: Shemaiah, an Israelite who was among those who had married foreign women during the exile.

H8098N.name: Shemaiah
H8098N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098N.short: Shemaiah, a descendant of Adonikam who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H8098O.name: Shemaiah
H8098O.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098O.short: Shemaiah, a Levite summoned by Ezra to join the return to Jerusalem.

H8098X.name: Shemaiah
H8098X.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098X.short: Shemaiah, a prophet from Kiriath-jearim who prophesied against Jerusalem during Jehoiakim's reign.

H8098Y.name: Shemaiah
H8098Y.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098Y.brief: False prophet during the Babylonian exile
H8098Y.short: Shemaiah, a false prophet who opposed Jeremiah during the Babylonian exile.

H8098Z.name: Shemaiah
H8098Z.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8098Z.short: Shemaiah, a scribe in the chamber of Elishama during the reign of King Jehoiakim.

H8098T.name: Shemaiah
H8098T.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098T.short: Shemaiah, a priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time and participated in the dedication of the wall.

H8098U.name: Shemaiah
H8098U.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098U.short: Shemaiah, a priest who played a trumpet during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

H8098V.name: Shemaiah
H8098V.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098V.short: Shemaiah, a priest who played an instrument during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

H8098W.name: Shemaiah
H8098W.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098W.short: Shemaiah, a Levite who led the singing during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

H8098R.name: Shemaiah
H8098R.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098R.brief: Levite who helped rebuild Jerusalem's wall
H8098R.short: Shemaiah, a Levite who made repairs to a section of Jerusalem's wall near his house.

H8098S.name: Shemaiah
H8098S.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8098S.short: Shemaiah, a false prophet who tried to intimidate Nehemiah during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall.

H8038.name: Shemeber
H8038.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8038.short: Shemeber, the king of Zeboiim, who joined the battle against Chedorlaomer and his allies.

H8061.name: Shemida
H8061.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8061.brief: Son of Gilead, great-grandson of Manasseh
H8061.short: Shemida, a son of Gilead and great-grandson of Manasseh, who was the ancestor of the Shemidaite clan.

H8070G.name: Shemiramoth
H8070G.desc: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8070G.short: Shemiramoth, a Levite appointed by David to play the harp and lyres in the procession of the ark.

H8070H.name: Shemiramoth
H8070H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8070H.short: Shemiramoth, a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

H8050I.name: Shemuel
H8050I.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8050I.brief: Son of Tola, a leader of Issachar
H8050I.short: Shemuel, a son of Tola and a leader of the tribe of Issachar during David's reign.

H8050H.name: Shemuel
H8050H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8050H.short: Shemuel, the son of Ammihud, appointed as the leader of the tribe of Simeon for land allotment.

H8006.name: Shillem
H8006.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8006.brief: Son of Naphtali, ancestor of the Shillemites
H8006.short: Shillem (or Shallum), a son of Naphtali and ancestor of the Shillemite clan.

H8023.name: Shilonites
H8023.brief: Descendants of Judah living in Jerusalem after the exile.
H8023.short: The Shilonites or Shiloni were descendants of Judah living in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H8030.name: Shilshah
H8030.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8030.brief: Son of Zophah, a descendant of Asher.
H8030.short: Shilshah was a son of Zophah and a descendant of Asher.

H8092G.name: Shimea
H8092G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8092G.brief: Levite of the family of Merari during David's reign.
H8092G.short: Shimea was a Levite of the family of Merari who served during King David's reign.

H8092H.name: Shimea
H8092H.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8092H.brief: Levite singer appointed by David for temple worship.
H8092H.short: Shimea was a Levite singer appointed by David to lead worship in the temple.

H8039.name: Shimeah
H8039.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8039.brief: Son of Mikloth and nephew of Ner in Benjamin's genealogy.
H8039.short: Shimeah (or Shimeam) was a Benjamite, son of Mikloth and nephew of Ner.

H8093.name: Shimeah
H8093.desc: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
H8093.brief: Brother of David; father of Jonadab (or 'Jonathan').
H8093.short: Shimeah (also known as Shimei, Shammah, or Shimea) was a brother of King David and the father of Jonadab (or 'Jonathan').

H8096O.name: Shimei
H8096O.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8096O.brief: Overseer of King David's vineyards from Ramah.
H8096O.short: Shimei from Ramah was the overseer of King David's vineyards.

H8096J.name: Shimei
H8096J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8096J.brief: Son of Pedaiah and nephew of King Jeconiah.
H8096J.short: Shimei was the son of Pedaiah and nephew of King Jeconiah, mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants.

H8096K.name: Shimei
H8096K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8096K.short: Shimei was a descendant of Judah through Mishma, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah's posterity.

H8096L.name: Shimei
H8096L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8096L.brief: Descendant of Reuben and son of Gog.
H8096L.short: Shimei was a descendant of Reuben and the son of Gog, mentioned in the genealogy of the Reubenites.

H8096M.name: Shimei
H8096M.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8096M.brief: Levite of the family of Merari.
H8096M.short: Shimei was a Levite of the family of Merari, mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites.

H8096V.name: Shimei
H8096V.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8096V.brief: Levite of the family of Ladan during David's reign.
H8096V.short: Shimei was a Levite of the family of Ladan who served during King David's reign.

H8096N.name: Shimei
H8096N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8096N.brief: Benjamite descendant of Shimei, son of Elpaal.
H8096N.short: Shimei was a Benjamite descendant of Shimei, the son of Elpaal.

H8096I.name: Shimei
H8096I.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H8096I.brief: Influential figure during Solomon's reign; son of Ela.
H8096I.short: Shimei was an influential figure during Solomon's reign and the son of Ela.

H8096P.name: Shimei
H8096P.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8096P.brief: Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.
H8096P.short: Shimei was a Levite who assisted in purifying the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H8096Q.name: Shimei
H8096Q.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8096Q.brief: Levite appointed as an overseer of temple contributions.
H8096Q.short: Shimei was a Levite appointed as an overseer of the contributions brought to the temple during Hezekiah's reign.

H8096H.name: Shimei
H8096H.desc: David's adversary living at the time of United Monarchy
H8096H.brief: Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion.
H8096H.short: Shimei was a Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion but later sought the king's forgiveness.

H8096U.name: Shimei
H8096U.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8096U.short: Shimei was a Benjamite, an ancestor of Mordecai, who lived in Susa during the Persian Empire.

H8096G.name: Shimei
H8096G.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8096G.brief: Son of Gershon and grandson of Levi.
H8096G.short: Shimei was a son of Gershon and grandson of Levi, and his descendants formed a Levitical clan.

H8096R.name: Shimei
H8096R.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8096R.brief: Levite who married a foreign wife during the exile.
H8096R.short: Shimei was a Levite who had married a foreign wife during the Babylonian exile and agreed to send her away.

H8096S.name: Shimei
H8096S.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8096S.brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife during the exile.
H8096S.short: Shimei was an Israelite who had married a foreign wife during the Babylonian exile and agreed to send her away.

H8096T.name: Shimei
H8096T.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8096T.brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife during the exile.
H8096T.short: Shimei was an Israelite who had married a foreign wife during the Babylonian exile and agreed to send her away.

H8095H.name: Shimeon
H8095H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8095H.brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife during the exile.
H8095H.short: Shimeon was an Israelite who had married a foreign wife during the Babylonian exile and agreed to send her away.

H8095G.name: Simeon
H8095G.desc: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8095G.brief: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.
H8095G.short: Simeon, the second son of Jacob and Leah, was the founder of the tribe of Simeon and played a role in the story of Joseph.

H8010.name: Solomon
H8010.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H8010.brief: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.
H8010.short: Solomon, also called Jedidiah, was the son of David and Bathsheba who succeeded his father as king of Israel and was renowned for his wisdom, wealth, and the construction of the First Temple in Jerusalem.

H8031.name: Shalishah
H8031.brief: Region Saul passed through seeking donkeys
H8031.short: Shalishah was a region Saul and his servant passed through while searching for his father's lost donkeys (<ref="1Sam. 9:4">1Sam. 9:4</ref>).

H8069H.name: Shamir
H8069H.brief: Issacharite judge who led Israel for 23 years
H8069H.short: Shamir, from the hill country of Ephraim, was an Issacharite who judged Israel for 23 years (<ref="Judg. 10:1-2">Judg. 10:1-2</ref>).

H8069G.name: Shamir
H8069G.brief: Town in the hill country of Judah
H8069G.short: Shamir was a town in the hill country of Judah (<ref="Josh. 15:48">Josh. 15:48</ref>).

H8090.name: Shema
H8090.brief: Town in the Negev region of Judah
H8090.short: Shema was a town in the Negev region of Judah (<ref="Josh. 15:26">Josh. 15:26</ref>).

H8067.name: Sheminith
H8067.brief: A musical term of uncertain meaning
H8067.short: Sheminith is a musical term that appears in the titles of <ref="Psalms 6; 12; 1Ch.15.21">Psalms 6; 12; 1Ch.15.21</ref>, possibly referring to a musical instrument, a part in music, or a melody.
